Hi Kimberly,

Following up from our SIG intake call — Aegis Health is preparing our SIG questionnaire and the auditor has asked for a recent example of a key rotation dry-run (canary) plus supporting operator artifacts. Specifically they want: 

- rotation manifest showing steps and timestamps (sample)
- operator shift logs for the window (include session IDs, obfuscated usernames)

- confirmation of retention policy & where the artifacts will be hosted for delivery

Can Redwood provide a redacted sample package and a brief narrative we can attach to the SIG (and CAIQ) evidence? Ideally delivered over SFTP or a restricted Drive folder. We need to include a statement about what was redacted and why.

Target timeline: our audit team asked that we have artifacts ready by Apr 7 so they can attach them to the submission. Let me know if that is feasible and if you need an NDA/LOU.

Thanks,
Lina
